name: Mixar 4.3.5
body:
# Mixar 4.3.5 — Technical Notes

Range: `v4.3.4..v4.3.5`.

## Updates (`common/updates`)
- New native pre-quit check, background wait and hardened Windows helper (v3); unquoted PID-wait pipe, persistent poll and live-PID probe (`win_installer.py`, `win_processes.py`).
- New `install_gate.py`, `install_marker.py` (an "updating" marker so a Mixar launched mid-install reports it and quits) and `result_report.py` for honest Windows self-update results.
- Mixar connectors (`mcp_bridge/core/installation.py`, `lease.py`) are ended before install rather than asking the user to close the AI app.
- Update telemetry extended (`update_events.py`); `atomic_json.py` utility added.

## Agent / Chat (`space_mixie_chat`)
- Send failures consolidated in `send_failure.py`: no delivery labels, one plain agent message, status-based wording, provider raw error shown; a resend awaiting its answer is not a lost response.
- BYOK card (`byok_card.py`): re-layout on move/refresh, ignores stale buttons, idempotent "Why", holds a refused interjection's card until the turn settles. Sign-in notice reads "Sign in & use Mixar credits" and pauses the account's own key.
- Agent socket: large frames sent in slices, reader woken on writer/backpressure drops, richer diagnostics (sleep, errno, reconnects, crashes) in `socket_diagnostics.py`.
- Composer focus changes no longer enter document undo; transactional chat keymap registration at startup.
- Export verification status wording (`export_verification_status.py`); new `moodboard_export.py` backing `export_moodboard_images`.

## BYOK / Local models
- `local_provider.py` / `context_probe.py`: warn when a custom local server's context window is too small; Local Save during "Starting…" waits; refusals name the missing step. Save outcome reporting moved to `save_events.py`.

## MCP bridge
- New `mixar_scene_close` tool; final `scene_limit` refusal naming tabs to reuse; `scene_busy` refusals name the holder.

## Moodboard
- Image generation uses the model's own catalog params; video-reference readiness isolated from background reconnects; generation dispatch failures clarified (`generation_dispatch.py`).

## Network
- `HTTPClient` never sleeps on a server `Retry-After` (`retry_policy.py`); 429 returns immediately as `RateLimitError`.

## Onboarding
- Honest tour telemetry (`start_source`, raw `stop_reason`, app quit = `interrupted`) and atomic seen-state writes.

## i18n
- Catalogs updated for all languages (undelivered-message line; delivery-label tokens removed).

## Build / Packaging
- `WIX.template`: removed duplicate `ARPINSTALLLOCATION`; `package.bat` finds a portable WiX 3 and links Dev installers with MSZIP.
- QA replays made deterministic/portable (free Moodboard, video reference, local-model privacy, member fixtures).

## ⚠️ Notes
- The viewport-relative agent pill positioning change was reverted.
- The Windows update flow changed substantially; verify updates on Windows when testing custom builds.
